name: Codeço endemic/epidemic cholera with aquatic reservoir and dose–response
description:
Cholera (Vibrio cholerae).
Parameter values: 6 of 6 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Codeço CT. Endemic and epidemic dynamics of cholera: the role of the aquatic reservoir. BMC Infect Dis 2001;1:1

compartments.name: R
compartments.description: recovered/removed. Added for bookkeeping: the original has only S and I with constant total H, and recovered people are

compartments.name: B
compartments.description: toxigenic V. cholerae concentration in water (cells/ml)

parameters.name: mu_h
parameters.description: human birth = death rate (the paper's n) (day^-1) [verified]

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: rate of exposure to contaminated water (day^-1) [verified]

parameters.name: K
parameters.description: concentration giving a 50% chance of infection (cells/ml) [verified]

parameters.name: nb_mb
parameters.description: net growth rate of vibrios, nb − mb. It is negative, so the population cannot persist without human input (day^-1) [verified]

parameters.name: e
parameters.description: contribution of each infected person to the aquatic population (cells ml^-1 day^-1 person^-1) [verified]

variables.name: lam_B
variables.description: probability of infection on exposure (saturating dose–response)

variables.name: S_crit
